title: Enterprise Desktop Support Runbook Library for Intune-Managed Windows
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (cross-domain endpoint troubleshooting/operations; diagnostic method + scripts, live-environment care).
Vendor/product-specific console internals are deferred to the vendor's official documentation; the Intune/Entra/Windows side is authored at exact click-by-click detail.
hook: Give every technician a repeatable way to own the problem end-to-end
problem: In a managed fleet, desktop issues get bounced between tiers because there's no standard way to triage them. This library gives you a Tier-1/Tier-2 runbook set for Intune-managed Windows — OS, hardware, profile, sign-in, and user-facing issues — each a repeatable, step-by-step diagnostic-to-resolution path with the exact checks, escalation gates, and evidence to collect, so technicians resolve issues consistently and own them end to end.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the support operating model (intake → triage → diagnose → resolve/escalate → document), how it maps to an Intune-managed fleet, and how the runbooks are structured.
Requirements Guide — what a technician needs (Intune roles, Graph read access, Remote Help/remote tools, asset context) with how to verify each.

Runbook Library — step-by-step runbooks for the common enterprise categories: sign-in/profile, OS/update, hardware/peripheral, app, network reachability, and enrollment/compliance — each with triage tree, checks, resolution, and escalation gate.
5 PowerShell scripts — endpoint health/context discovery, per-device state validation, a support-metrics/health report, safe common-fix remediation, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates per runbook, plus Best Practices for consistent triage, evidence capture, and escalation.
short: A Tier-1/Tier-2 runbook library for Intune-managed Windows — OS, hardware, profile, sign-in, and user-facing issues — each a repeatable diagnose-to-resolve path with escalation gates. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A Tier-1/Tier-2 runbook library for Intune-managed Windows — OS, hardware, profile, sign-in, and user-facing issues — each a repeatable diagnose-to-resolve path with escalation gates.
